edit.templateHelp: Variables: {vars}. Empty parts are skipped and the file extension is added automatically. {edition} is the deluxe/special qualifier (empty for the standard edition, so it collapses), and {disc} only appears for multi-disc albums. Tracks with no album use the Singles template; files we can't identify (no artist tag) use the Unidentified one.

pairing.title: Connect a library server
pairing.intro: Your music lives on a computer of yours running the Chordia library server. Pairing lets this phone reach it: songs stream straight from that machine and never pass through Chordia.
pairing.stepStartBody: On the computer holding your music, start Chordia Library. The first time it runs it prints a one-time setup link in its terminal.
pairing.stepLinkBody: It looks like https://192.168.1.20:8443/setup/abc123. Copy the whole line, including the code at the end.
pairing.linkInvalid: That is not a setup link. It ends in /setup/ followed by the one-time code the server printed.
pairing.trustBody: {host} signed its own certificate, which is normal for a home server. From now on this phone accepts only this exact certificate and refuses anything else, which is what makes a self-signed server safe to stream from.
pairing.claimingBody: Chordia is issuing a one-time pass, good for two minutes and for nothing but this handshake, and handing it to the server. Your sign-in never leaves this phone.
pairing.ticketExpired: The one-time pass ran out before the server answered. Nothing was lost; try again.
pairing.nameBody: One server can hold several libraries. This is the name you will see on this phone.
pairing.doneBody: The server is scanning its folders now. Tracks appear as they are indexed.
pairing.unreachable: Could not reach {host}. Check the server is running and that this phone is on the same network.
pairing.refused: The server would not accept that setup link. A link works once; restart the library server to print a fresh one.

discord.help: Bots that play this library into voice channels. Tokens stay in the library's config file; everything else about a bot is set here.
